notes: Sources: Dreamcast Controller Instruction Manual (Sega of America 1999, part 670-14112B; archive.org Dreamcast_Controller_Instruction_Manual_1999_U) and the Dreamcast console Instruction Manual (Sega, US, 2000; archive.org DreamCast_Instruction_Manual_2000_Sega_US), whose controller diagram labels D-Pad, X/Y/B/A Buttons, Start Button, Trigger R, Trigger L and Expansion Sockets 1 and 2; the controller manual adds the Analog Thumb Pad. Quotes retain the maker manual's archive.org OCR text and spacing; the cited control facts were checked against rendered page images (controller instruction manual PDF leaf 3, Part Names and Functions, plus its leaf 4 operation text) on 2026-11-01. The page image is authoritative where OCR differs. Together they are read as the complete control and port lists: dpad 1; Analog Thumb Pad = stick 1; A/B/X/Y = face_button 4; Trigger L/R = trigger 2 (analog triggers, not bumpers); Start = button 1; Expansion Sockets 1 and 2 = expansion_slot 2 (they take the Visual Memory Unit and other peripherals); the permanently attached controller cable = cable 1. DIMENSIONS NOT FILED: the Science Museum Group record co8912915 (a Dreamcast console set, object 2024-692/1) prints the controller as «overall (excluding cable): 80 mm x 140 mm x 140 mm» with the axes UNLABELLED and rounded to 10 mm, so no axis can be assigned; the record could not be re-fetched (the SMG site returned 403 to this lane after a rate limit) and a human should check whether it labels the axes. Mass and cable length: not published in either manual, null. Sega's history archive (sega.jp/history/hard/dreamcast/) is 403 to automated fetches.
